description: Plan, create and schedule social media posts in Buffer from ChatGPT. Draft ideas and posts, schedule them, edit or delete posts, and manage post templates. Works with the channels connected to your Buffer account on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, X, YouTube, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest, Google Business Profiles and Substack. Requires a Buffer account with connected channels.

interface.longDescription: Plan, create and schedule social media posts in Buffer from ChatGPT. Draft ideas and posts, schedule them, edit or delete posts, and manage post templates. Works with the channels connected to your Buffer account on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, X, YouTube, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest, Google Business Profiles and Substack. Requires a Buffer account with connected channels.

name: buffer

positive.description: Run this case in a fresh conversation. See which social channels are connected to the Buffer account.
positive.prompt: Which social media channels are connected to my Buffer account?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the organization (My organization) and lists its 2 connected channels, an Instagram account and a Facebook Page, with each channel's name and network.

positive.description: Run this case in a fresh conversation. Add a text post to the Facebook Page queue.
positive.prompt: In Buffer, add a post to my Facebook Page queue that says "Testing Buffer from ChatGPT" followed by today's date and the current time, so it is unique.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a Facebook post (type post) whose text starts with "Testing Buffer from ChatGPT" to the next open slot in the Facebook Page's queue. Confirms the channel and the organization (My organization). The post appears in the Page's queue in Buffer.

positive.description: Run this case in a fresh conversation. Save, edit and delete a draft post in one conversation.
positive.prompt: In Buffer, save a draft post for my Facebook Page that says "Temporary review post". Then change its text to "Edited review post". Then delete it.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a Facebook draft post (type post) with the text "Temporary review post", edits that same draft so its text is "Edited review post" and it stays a draft, then deletes it and reports that it was deleted. Nothing is scheduled or published. ChatGPT may ask the user to confirm each write (create_post, edit_post, delete_post). No other post is changed or deleted.

positive.description: Run this case in a fresh conversation. Save a content idea for later.
positive.prompt: Save an idea in Buffer titled "5 tips for planning a monthly content calendar".
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an idea titled "5 tips for planning a monthly content calendar" in My organization and confirms it was saved, naming the organization.

positive.description: Run this case in a fresh conversation. Create a reusable post template.
positive.prompt: Create a private post template in Buffer called "Weekly tip" with the text "Tip of the week: {{tip}}" and the description "A weekly tip post".
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private post template named "Weekly tip" with that body and description in My organization, and confirms it was created.

negative.description: Payments are out of scope. Buffer schedules social posts and cannot move money, so the plugin should call no tools and explain that it can't help with payments.
negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my Buffer account to my bank account.

negative.description: Connecting a new channel needs the user to authorize the network in Buffer itself. No tool can do it, so the plugin should explain how to connect a channel in Buffer and not attempt it.
negative.prompt: Connect my TikTok account to Buffer.

negative.description: The account has no LinkedIn channel connected. The plugin should check the connected channels, say no LinkedIn channel exists, and not post to a different channel instead.
negative.prompt: In Buffer, post "We're hiring!" to my LinkedIn page now.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0, initial release. Plan, create, schedule, edit and delete social media posts in Buffer from ChatGPT, save content ideas, and manage post templates.
